thread:
Maria: Quick check — who can take the 14:00 UTC deploy slot tomorrow? We need smoke owners, someone watching metrics, and a rollback-ready person. It's a runtime + API push (no migrations).
Alex: I can take it. I’ll own the deploy for api/gateway and rate-limiter.
Tessa: I’ll do regression smoke for embeddings + rerank. Can you post the smoke checklist link here?
Maria: Thanks — services touched: api, routing, redis config, rt-inference. No DB migrations. Smoke checklist: see below and I'll paste the playbook link after.
Ken: No migrations — happy to be rollback lead if anything goes sideways. What's our canary ramp plan?
Samira: Suggest 10% for 10m -> 50% for 10m -> 100%. I’ll configure alerts and watch the dashboard.
Alex: Cool. I’ll prepare a small smoke script to validate health + a basic generate call.
Alex: ```
# smoke.sh
curl -fsS https://api.redwood.dev/health || { echo 'health failed'; exit 1; }
curl -fsS -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}' | jq . || { echo 'generate failed'; exit 1; }
echo 'smoke passed'
```
Tessa: I’ll run that during the smoke window and report results here. Also please add the regression prompts set so I can validate output quality quickly.
Maria: Playbook: https://go.redwood/playbooks/deploy-rollback — includes rollback commands and kube labels to flip.
deploy-bot: Deploy slot scheduled: 2026-03-18 14:00:00 UTC for #release-train. Reminder: 60m before. Slot owner: Maria (requested).
Alex: Heads-up: PR #345 (gate-timeout-fix) contains a tiny config change needed for the gateway timeout. It is merged to main but needs a quick smoke pass.
Ken: I’ll be on-call 14:00-15:00 UTC and can run the rollback if required. :thumbsup: If rollback needed, prefer to revert to tag `release-2026-03-10`.
Samira: I’ll set canary thresholds: latency alert if p95 > 150ms or error-rate > 0.5% during ramp. Will post screenshot of the alert rule shortly.
Tessa: RSVP: I’ll join the 14:00 smoke and will run full smoke + regression prompts.
Maria: Owners summary: Alex (deploy lead), Tessa (smoke/regression), Samira (monitoring/alerts), Ken (rollback). If anyone swaps, update this thread.
Alex: One more: can someone confirm quota bump for model-serving? We might need a short burst.
Samira: I just requested temporary quota bump from infra; should be approved before the slot.
Maria: Perfect. Thanks everyone — see you in the deploy window. If anything changes, update here. :raised_hands:
